runner_source:
require 'json';require 'digest';require 'open3';require 'fileutils'
o=File.expand_path(__dir__);out=o+'/report.json';raise 'Existing evidence' if File.exist?(out)
base=File.expand_path('../struct-replacement-2026-10-29/baseline',o)
artifacts={'baseline'=>File.expand_path('../nested-collection-v1-2026-10-29',o),'candidate'=>File.expand_path('../struct-literal-v2-2026-10-29',o)}
r={status:'running',pid:Process.pid,scope:'Direct root-array struct replacement; baseline 2a5ffbc versus unaccepted struct-v2; allocation evidence only',identities:{},sources:{},rows:[],semantics:[]};save=->{File.write(out,JSON.pretty_generate(r)+"\n")}
artifacts.each{|k,d|%w[candidate-kujo task-allocation-probe].each{|f|r[:identities][d+'/'+f]=Digest::SHA256.file(d+'/'+f).hexdigest}}
begin
 [2,2048].product(%w[once fresh],[16,32]).each do |width,snapshot,calls|
  name=['root','literal',width,snapshot,calls].join('-');d=o+'/'+name;FileUtils.mkdir_p(d)
  owner=File.read(base+'/'+name+'/owner.kujo').sub('mut seed := {}','mut seed := []').sub('seed[j] = Item { value: 0 }','seed = push(seed, Item { value: 0 })')
  main=File.read(base+'/'+name+'/main.kujo');File.write(d+'/owner.kujo',owner);File.write(d+'/main.kujo',main)
  [owner,main].each{|s|r[:sources][Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(s)]=s}
  artifacts.each do |kind,a|
   %w[vm interpreter jit].each do |mode|
    args=[a+'/candidate-kujo','run',d+'/main.kujo','--untrusted'];args<<'--'+mode unless mode=='vm';stdout,stderr,s=Open3.capture3(*args)
    raise stdout+stderr unless s.success?&&stdout=="STRUCT REPLACEMENT PASS\n"
    r[:semantics]<<{kind:kind,width:width,snapshot:snapshot,calls:calls,mode:mode,argv:args,exit:s.exitstatus,stdout:stdout,stderr:stderr};save.call
   end
   %w[vm jit].each do |mode|
    args=[a+'/task-allocation-probe',mode,d+'/main.kujo'];stdout,stderr,s=Open3.capture3(*args);m=stderr.match(/ALLOCATION_AUDIT requests=(\d+) requested_bytes=(\d+)/)
    raise stdout+stderr unless s.success?&&stdout=="STRUCT REPLACEMENT PASS\n"&&m
    r[:rows]<<{kind:kind,width:width,snapshot:snapshot,calls:calls,mode:mode,argv:args,requests:m[1].to_i,bytes:m[2].to_i};save.call
   end
  end
 end
 r[:identities].each{|p,h|raise 'Artifact drift' unless Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest==h}
 r[:status]='characterized';save.call
rescue=>e;r[:status]='failed';r[:error]=e.message;save.call;raise
end
puts 'Root-array characterization complete'
verifier_source:
require 'json';require 'digest'
o=File.expand_path(__dir__);p=o+'/report.json';r=JSON.parse(File.read(p));raise 'Incomplete' unless r['status']=='characterized'
keys=%w[kind width snapshot calls mode]
expected=%w[baseline candidate].product([2,2048],%w[once fresh],[16,32],%w[vm jit]);raise 'Allocation coverage' unless r['rows'].map{|x|x.values_at(*keys)}.sort==expected.sort
expected=%w[baseline candidate].product([2,2048],%w[once fresh],[16,32],%w[vm interpreter jit]);raise 'Semantic coverage' unless r['semantics'].map{|x|x.values_at(*keys)}.sort==expected.sort
r['identities'].each{|p,h|raise 'Artifact drift' unless Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest==h}
r['sources'].each{|h,s|raise 'Embedded source drift' unless Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(s)==h}
r['semantics'].each do |x|
 raise 'Output' unless x['exit']==0&&x['stdout']=="STRUCT REPLACEMENT PASS\n"
 d=o+'/root-literal-'+x.values_at('width','snapshot','calls').join('-');%w[main owner].each{|n|s=File.read(d+'/'+n+'.kujo');raise 'Source drift' unless r['sources'][Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(s)]==s}
 owner=File.read(d+'/owner.kujo');raise 'Wrong collection' unless owner.include?('mut seed := []')&&owner.include?('seed = push(seed, Item { value: 0 })')&&owner.include?('state[0] = Item { value: n }')
end
slopes=r['rows'].group_by{|x|x.values_at('kind','width','snapshot','mode')}.map do |group,rows|
 a,b=rows.sort_by{|x|x['calls']};{group:group,bytes_per_added_call:(b['bytes']-a['bytes'])/16.0,requests_per_added_call:(b['requests']-a['requests'])/16.0}
end
v={status:'characterized',allocation_observations:32,semantic_checks:48,slopes:slopes,report_sha256:Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest,runner_sha256:Digest::SHA256.file(o+'/measure.rb').hexdigest,verifier_sha256:Digest::SHA256.file(__FILE__).hexdigest,limits:'Root array and struct payload only. Candidate unaccepted. Fresh-snapshot allocation offsets retained; this is baseline characterization, not fix acceptance or speed evidence.'}
File.write(o+'/verification.json',JSON.pretty_generate(v)+"\n");puts '32 allocation observations and 48 semantic checks verified'
